days.title: Alpine lakes, then Oamaru.
days.intro: Arrive in Christchurch, keep the Tekapo lakefront and Lake Pukaki stops, pause in Twizel, then follow the Waitaki Valley via Omarama and Kurow to Oamaru for the first night.
timeline: Immigration, bags and biosecurity. The flight is still an unbooked candidate; queues can move the whole schedule.
Collect the car, breakfast, water, fuel and food for Christmas. Arrange Oamaru arrival / key collection before starting the drive.
Drive through Geraldine and Fairlie, with a rest break. Both remain on the route.
Church of the Good Shepherd + lakefront
Keep the existing church, lake views, photos and lunch stop. Interior access is not assumed.
Allow driving from Tekapo, then 20–30 minutes for lake views and photos.
Fuel, toilets and a short rest. Twizel remains a stop, but the overnight moves to Oamaru.
Twizel → Oamaru via the Waitaki Valley
Allow roughly 2–2.5 hours including a short break via Omarama, Otematata and Kurow. Do not add every viewpoint to the default schedule.
Hotel not yet selected or booked. Confirm late arrival in advance and have food supplies if kitchens / restaurants are closed.
A brief outdoor harbour / heritage stroll is the lower-effort choice. Penguin viewing needs a confirmed dated ticket and start time, and can finish late. Choose sleep if tired.
days.note: Long arrival day: road-routing baseline is about 5.9 hours before breaks; budget 6–7 hours driving and arrival around 19:15–19:45 if the morning runs to plan. Keep every main stop, but shorten visits if delayed. Optional activities remain listed as alternatives; they cannot all fit. If fatigue makes the drive unsafe, stop and change the overnight plan rather than force the Oamaru arrival.

carRental.extras: Set aside a further NZ$200–450 for possible one-way / airport fees and optional excess reduction: provisional rental budget NZ$680–1,330 before fuel, parking and any refundable bond. Actual quotes may fall outside this allowance.

Confirm that your programme covers New Zealand and personal / leisure rentals; negotiated cover and benefits depend on the agreement.

days.optionalIntro: All original Tekapo options remain available as choices, but Oamaru adds about two hours beyond Twizel. A paid Tekapo activity or Mt John walk pushes check-in later and competes with the Oamaru evening. Choose at most one substantive activity, confirm late hotel access, and protect rest before Christmas Day.

optionalActivities.name: Tekapo Springs hot pools
optionalActivities.duration: Allow 60–90 min + changing / local detour
optionalActivities.fit: Optional only if rested; adds 60–90+ min and needs later Oamaru check-in
optionalActivities.description: A relaxed hot-pool soak overlooking the lake. Confirm the 24 Dec session and opening hours; do not add a late booking after a delayed flight.
optionalActivities.cost: Paid entry · exact-date price to check

optionalActivities.name: Dark Sky Experience · indoor astronomy
optionalActivities.duration: 45 min tour; allow 65–80 min including check-in
optionalActivities.fit: Swap for part of Tekapo time; later Oamaru arrival unless time is recovered
optionalActivities.description: An all-weather daytime astronomy experience. This is not outdoor stargazing. Reserve a slot compatible with your actual arrival; the night tours would require a different overnight plan.
optionalActivities.cost: Paid tour · book a timed slot

optionalActivities.name: Mt John summit walk
optionalActivities.duration: Allow 1.5–2 hr from Tekapo Springs trailhead
optionalActivities.fit: Retained as a longer alternative; needs a major timing change, not an automatic addition
optionalActivities.description: Panoramic lake and basin views. Pin marks the approximate walking start, not summit vehicle access. The 3-hour lakeshore loop is too much for the default arrival schedule. Check DOC conditions before choosing.

optionalActivities.name: Oamaru heritage precinct + harbour
optionalActivities.duration: Allow 20–40 min
optionalActivities.fit: After check-in if rested, or a brief daylight look before Day 02 departure
optionalActivities.description: Outdoor heritage streets around Harbour Street and the harbour edge. Evening shop / museum opening is not assumed. Steampunk HQ’s interior closes at 16:00 and is closed Christmas Day, so it is not feasible in this schedule.

optionalActivities.name: Oamaru Penguins · evening viewing
optionalActivities.duration: Allow 1–2 hr; summer viewing can finish as late as 23:00
optionalActivities.fit: Only with a compatible dated start time and enough energy after the drive
optionalActivities.description: Watch little penguins return at dusk. The operator’s current daily start time is not the 24 Dec timetable: verify the booked date. Pre-book only after flight and hotel timing are clear. No photos / filming during evening viewing. A late finish conflicts with the early Day 02 start.
optionalActivities.cost: Published adult general NZ$47; premium NZ$63. Exact-date availability unconfirmed; optional, outside hotel cap.

days.title: Into the Southern Alps.
days.region: Oamaru - Waitaki Valley - Mount Cook - Lindis Pass - Queenstown
days.intro: Leave Oamaru early, return through the Waitaki Valley and Twizel, keep the Mount Cook short-walk visit, then cross Lindis Pass toward Queenstown. This preserves all existing main destinations with a longer driving day.
timeline: Use supplies bought on 24 Dec. Check roads, DOC alerts and weather. A late penguin night makes this early departure harder.
Oamaru → Mount Cook via Kurow, Omarama and Twizel
Allow about 3h 15m including fuel, breaks and the drive beside Lake Pukaki. Any Elephant Rocks detour adds time to this block.
Kea Point / Mount Cook village views
Keep the original two-hour alpine visit, including local access / parking. Choose a short walk according to conditions; do not substitute a long hike without changing the schedule.
Do not rely on normal restaurant or supermarket hours.
Drive back beside Pukaki, past Twizel and Omarama, with breaks and a brief viewpoint stop at Lindis Pass.
Retain the scenic transfer and fuel / photo stops. Arrival allowance includes holiday traffic and a rest break; no long detour assumed.
Accommodation still to be booked. Arrange dinner or supplies ahead of time and rest before the Milford coach day.
days.note: Oamaru adds backtracking: the road-route baseline is about 6.2 hours before breaks; allow 7–8 hours driving. All original main stops and optional alternatives are retained. Keep the two-hour Mount Cook visit; one added stop can shift Queenstown arrival later, while multiple excursions require a different schedule. Default departure is 07:00 only if adequately rested.
days.optionalIntro: Both original Mount Cook options are retained. The Oamaru start makes this a longer 7–8-hour driving day: choose a substitute at Mount Cook OR one brief Waitaki detour. Do not book several timed activities on the same transfer day.

optionalActivities.name: Tasman Glacier View Track
optionalActivities.duration: 30 min return walk; allow 60–90 min with road detour and parking
optionalActivities.fit: Best as an alternative to the main Mount Cook walk
optionalActivities.description: A short, steep climb with 300+ steps above Tasman Lake. Pin marks the approximate car park. DOC lists the village-to-car-park drive at about 10 min each way; check conditions and avoid adding both long walks.
optionalActivities.cost: No walk booking; parking shown free by DOC when checked

optionalActivities.name: Mount Cook scenic flight
optionalActivities.duration: Reserve a 1.5–2 hr schedule window; flight length varies
optionalActivities.fit: Replace the main walk; advance booking required
optionalActivities.description: Scenic ski-plane / helicopter operators serve the national park. Pin marks the airport area, not a booked operator. Confirm Christmas service, check-in, weather cancellation terms and a departure that still allows the Queenstown drive.
optionalActivities.cost: Paid experience · operator quote required

optionalActivities.name: Elephant Rocks · Duntroon
optionalActivities.duration: Allow 30–45 min extra including access detour, parking and a short look
optionalActivities.fit: Optional early stop only; shifts the Mount Cook / Queenstown timetable
optionalActivities.description: Limestone formations near Duntroon on the Oamaru–Waitaki Valley approach. On private working farmland: follow access signs, keep gates as instructed and check current permission. The tourism board describes a short walk from the road.
optionalActivities.cost: Entry by donation; parking / access conditions to confirm

days.title: A day in Fiordland.

timeline: Rain layer, warm top, lunch and insect repellent.
Actual pickup comes from the tour you book.
The operator chooses stops; Mirror Lakes is representative.
Cruise time and meals depend on the selected departure.
Allow about five hours coach travel with stops.
No extra driving or evening excursion planned.

days.optionalIntro: The coach-and-cruise day is already 12–13 hours. Your coach operator controls road stops and return time: these are requests or package alternatives, not independent additions. No extra Queenstown adventure is planned after the return.

optionalActivities.fit: Only if the coach gives enough free time

Allow a scenic roadside stop on the lake road.
Lagoon walk and views, or a booked short guided tour.
Back to Queenstown; collect bags and fuel the car.
Easy lakefront time. Arrowtown is optional, not included.
Allow international check-in time; rental branch to be chosen.
Local times; Melbourne is two hours behind NZ. Virgin option found, not booked.

Allow traffic and a rest break on the approach.
Short beach/viewpoint visits and picnic; no long hike.
A440 / Sale / Princes Highway, with fuel and breaks.
Holiday park cabin or motel, subject to availability.
Keep it short after a substantial driving day.

Short wharf/lookout visit and an early lunch.
A quick beach or inlet visit; do not add a long walk.
Final drive, then hotel check-in; allow traffic.
Easy evening and prepare for tomorrow.

Brief Audley stop, subject to roads and parking.
CBD return branch and hotel not chosen; allow traffic.

guangzhouVisit.title: Guangzhou in a morning?
guangzhouVisit.eligibility: 24-hour visa-free airside transit includes Indian passport holders. A city visit additionally requires a temporary entry permit issued by Guangzhou border inspection. National policy allows passengers to apply, but approval is not automatic.
guangzhouVisit.restriction: Indian passport holders may apply for a 24-hour temporary entry permit; approval is discretionary. India’s exclusion from the separate 240-hour scheme is not itself a blanket ban on applying under the 24-hour process. China Southern’s Guangzhou page nevertheless warns that permits are generally not issued outside the longer-transit nationality list; it uses outdated 144-hour wording, so confirm current local handling with immigration.
guangzhouVisit.decision: Keep the airport stay as the default. Seek confirmation from China immigration (+86 20 12367, listed by Baiyun Airport) and China Southern for two Indian passport holders on CZ 360 → CZ 3051, 23 Dec 2026, 11h 05m transit. Do not book non-refundable tours. If either traveller is refused entry, both stay airside.
guangzhouVisit.permitFee: Budget ¥0 for visa-free transit / a transit temporary entry permit if granted. This is an expectation, not a confirmed Guangzhou 24-hour permit tariff: an official Shanghai FAQ confirms no temporary-entry-permit fee under the 240-hour scheme, while the Guangzhou 24-hour pages checked do not state a fee. Confirm with Guangzhou immigration. A paid Chinese visa is a separate process and is not included.
guangzhouVisit.storage: Assumes one cabin suitcase each (two pieces total). Use the staffed T2 landside storage only after immigration has admitted both travellers. Airport-listed T2 storage phone: +86 176 2340 5052. China Southern’s T2 FAQ lists storage in the departures hall Cloud Market and near arrivals Gate 53. Confirm your actual terminal, counter hours and collection deadline.
guangzhouVisit.storagePrice: Allow ¥20–55 per bag, or ¥40–110 for two, for the day. This is an indicative third-party range, not an airport-confirmed tariff. Extra backpacks may be charged separately. Keep passports, boarding passes, medicines, valuables and any items the counter will not accept with you; retain the storage receipt.
guangzhouVisit.transport: From T2, use Airport North metro station. Line 3 reaches Tiyu Xilu; follow current station routing onward to Zhujiang New Town and walk to Huacheng Square. The official Tianhe guide gives ¥7–8 and 35–40 minutes to Tiyu Xilu; budget ¥10–15 and 60–80 minutes door-to-door each way per person to the sightseeing area, including walking and transfers. Metro starts around 06:00.
guangzhouVisit.sights: One compact area: Huacheng Square → Guangzhou Opera House exterior → Pearl River waterfront for Canton Tower skyline photos. Choose breakfast / an early lunch nearby. No tower ascent, cruise, museum interiors or cross-city detour is included; this is a short daytime visit, not the illuminated evening skyline.
timeline: Follow staff directions to the temporary-entry counter; allow for queues and screening. If admitted, store the bags and check the return route.
Leave only if BOTH entry permits are granted, bags are stored and onward boarding requirements are clear. Otherwise keep the airport plan.
Allow 60–80 minutes door-to-door; adjust the sightseeing start to actual clearance.
Opera House exterior, waterfront and Canton Tower views from the north bank. Outdoor stops only.
Allow ¥120–180 total for food and drinks across the outing.
Skip remaining stops if delayed. Keep the return deadline fixed.
Back at the correct airport terminal
Collect bags by roughly 13:15, then complete airline formalities, exit immigration and security. Allow more time if the airline requires it.
Follow the actual boarding time and gate shown by the airline.

guangzhouVisit.total: Metro outing: ¥250–450 total for two. These are planning allowances, not a bookable quote; any separately required Chinese visa is excluded.
guangzhouVisit.taxi: Taxi alternative: allow ¥300–450 total for the return car journeys, replacing the ¥40–60 metro line. Total outing budget: ¥510–840 for two. This is an allowance, not a live metered fare; traffic and tolls affect the final cost. Allow 60–90 minutes per leg.
guangzhouVisit.fx: All foreign-currency amounts show an approximate INR equivalent using the planning rates in the budget box. Card / cash-exchange charges and December rates will differ.
guangzhouVisit.fallback: If city entry is not approved, remain in the international transit area with cabin bags. The proposed landside storage and sightseeing plan then does not apply. Allow roughly ¥120–240 for two people’s airport meals and drinks; any lounge is extra and must be confirmed airside-accessible.
